svg.title: TurboVLA training step
svg.desc: Samples are drawn from simulated and real recordings at a set ratio, images are resized to 224, state and actions min-max scaled to [-1, 1]. DINOv3, the interaction layers and the decoder are trained while BERT stays frozen. The loss is a masked L1 over 16 steps with an optional gripper weight; AdamW with warm-up and a cosine schedule updates the weights, and an exponential moving average of them is saved for rollout.
svg.text: TurboVLA learns from mixed real and simulated runs.

g.text: bf16 autocast · BERT gets no grad
bold row: gripper, optional weight w

svg.text: source · examples/nexarm/train_turbovla.py · 50,000 steps · click a block or use the arrow keys
